# Phase 4 — PostgreSQL Persistence

Follow Copilot instructions. Implement PostgreSQL persistence strictly against DATA-MODEL and lifecycle specs: migrations, connection handling, repository interfaces/implementations, transaction boundaries and persistence for request-related records needed by current phases. Use parameterized queries, bounded pools/timeouts, migration checks and test isolation. Avoid adding schema tables or fields without traceability. Add integration tests using approved local/test setup; never target production data. Acceptance: clean migrations reproducible, transaction/integrity behaviors tested, repositories isolated behind interfaces, no injection risk, failures normalized. If database library or migration tool is undecided, present a small justified choice and pause for approval.
